correlation_estimand: Maximum absolute pooled lagged Pearson correlation across both cost coordinates and lags 1 through max_lag. Lag pairs are pooled across runs and time within each horizon; no detrending or arm residualization.
distribution_estimand: Maximum pairwise energy distance between iteration-specific cost distributions conditional on each arm. Energy distance is sqrt(2 E||X-Y|| - E||X-X'|| - E||Y-Y'||) on fixed-bound normalized cost vectors.
resampling: Resample independent whole trajectories with replacement, using the same trajectory weights for every arm, time, coordinate, and horizon.
inference: Exploratory approximate cluster-bootstrap confidence bounds, pointwise in horizon. Correlation bounds cover all coordinate/lag pairs; distribution bounds cover all arm/time pairs within each horizon. Neither is a finite-sample coverage guarantee. The two families are not jointly adjusted.
tolerance_note: Exploratory sensitivity values approved before this analysis. These are not established practical acceptability limits. No simulation, training, burn-in, or alteration of existing tests.
